_comment: Duke Energy FY2025 (data/edgar/DUK.json) plus illustrative market inputs (risk-free = 10yr UST, ERP = Damodaran implied ERP, unlevered beta = 0.35 -- illustrative, Damodaran-style, the lowest of any sector this toolkit has profiled, see finmodel.sectors.SECTOR_PROFILES['utility'] -- relevered to DUK's own FY2025 market-value capital structure via finmodel.wacc.relever_beta to 0.622). Coverage-based synthetic rating (ebit/interest_expense) gives 'BB+' here -- a real, verified MISMATCH against DUK's actual investment-grade rating (BBB/S&P, Baa2/Moody's, both stable, Feb 2026): regulated utilities are allowed to run structurally low coverage because rate-of-return regulation makes debt-service recovery through rates close to guaranteed, something the coverage ratio alone can't see. Kept as real, uncorrected output -- see docs/FOOTBALL_FIELD_DUK.md for the full writeup.
